exp1.description: Repeatability of the v0.1 negative transfer result across 30 seeds, with AGM v0.1 and v0.2.

exp2.description: Transfer matrix: per target domain, AGM v0.2 cold vs AGM v0.2 with memory from one source domain (paired by seed).

criteria.statement: Architectural principles can be extracted from experience.
criteria.evidence: 2735 principle records across memory files; status counts {'INCONCLUSIVE': 526, 'PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED': 36, 'UNTESTED': 2173}

criteria.statement: Principles can be experimentally validated (tested under new conditions with recorded outcomes).
criteria.evidence: 233 principle tests recorded in transfer targets; 36 principles reached a non-UNTESTED status

criteria.statement: Validated principles transfer to a genuinely different domain (principle-derived architectures instantiated and evaluated in the target).
Transfer reduces adaptation/search cost (paired Δ adaptation cost < 0 with 95% CI excluding 0, or Δ evaluations-to-target < 0 likewise).
criteria.evidence: cells with significant cost reduction: ['C->B']; with significant cost increase: ['B->A', 'C->A', 'A->C', 'B->C']; with significant evaluations-to-target reduction: ['C->B']

criteria.statement: The machine decides not to adapt when adaptation is uneconomical (DO_NOT_ADAPT occurs; always-adapt spends more evaluations without higher quality).

Useful transferred architectures are not merely memorized copies (structural distance between transferred and cold final architectures > 0 in some cells, and transferred architectures differ from source architectures).
criteria.evidence: cells where transferred final architecture differs structurally from the cold final: ['C->B', 'A->C', 'B->C']; fraction identical per cell: {'B->A': 1.0, 'C->A': 1.0, 'A->B': 1.0, 'C->B': 0.8, 'A->C': 0.9, 'B->C': 0.9}

criteria.statement: The benefit survives multiple random seeds (criterion D holds with n ≥ 30 paired seeds and CI excluding 0).
